recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no FHIR core source follow-up is needed unless Pharmacy later changes the broader reason CodeableReference model or permitted reason target resources.
issue_request: FHIR-12174 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request from DSTU2 asking to support observations such as BP, pulse, or INR as related reasons for MedicationOrder and MedicationAdministration, with a 2016-10-17 vote to add reason reference to Observation.
initial_application: Commit 1d00edee4413c641918bdf96071c2407902bc4c3 explicitly included "#12174 - added observation as a reason" and changed the old MedicationOrder.reasonReference and MedicationAdministration.reasonReference definitions to allow Observation.
additional_context: MedicationOrder/MedicationPrescription is now represented by active MedicationRequest source. Later Pharmacy changes, especially FHIR-25929, migrated separate reasonCode/reasonReference choices to CodeableReference, so the current correct representation is MedicationRequest.reason and MedicationAdministration.reason with Observation targetProfile entries.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the active current StructureDefinitions already include Observation on both relevant reason elements and adding old reasonReference wording would be stale.
